title: ubiqX AI - Launch film, draft B: "Você não deu play."
angle: B - relentless product montage (Linear/Raycast): cold open on the real dashboard with a 3D push inside the first second, then one idea per 1-2 s on the real UI - camera pushes into exact hotspots, a keycap, cursor clicks and state changes (the queue shrinks after "1", "Confirmar os 19", the report writes itself) - kinetic headlines between beats, a Captura/Classifica/Revisa/Entrega crescendo, one beat of silence, the wordmark drop and the CTA.

conventions.grid: beat = 15 f, bar = 60 f; every scene start is a multiple of 15
conventions.relativeFrames: all frames inside a scene (copy, camera, cursor, motion, sfx) are relative to the scene startFrame
conventions.uiPlane: Screen width W = 1600 px unless a scene says otherwise (window 1600 x 1000 at zoom 1). On-screen UI size = capture px x (W / 2880) x zoom; bitmap upsampling = (W / 2880) x zoom.
conventions.textBearingZoom: any UI text we zoom INTO is >= 36 px on screen (see zoomCheck). Where that needs bitmap upsampling > 1.15, a crisp patch is mandatory (live HTML re-typeset of the exact UI string/element glued to the hotspot as a Screen child, same font/size/colour), and everything outside the hotspot gets DOF blur >= 4 px + dim >= 0.5. Preferred alternative for the patch: recapture that hotspot at DPR 4 with tools/capture-ui.mjs (newPage supports dpr).
conventions.copyFields: inFrame = first frame of the entrance; landFrame = frame the last word/line has landed (spring >= 0.9); outFrame = first frame of the exit or the cut; hold = outFrame - landFrame >= max(24, 2 x chars) (slam words: >= 12 f each, final >= 30 f)
conventions.transitions: no overlapping TransitionSeries: each transition is split into an outgoing half at the end of scene N (framesOut) and an incoming half at the start of scene N+1 (framesIn), same type name and total frames on both sides; symmetric transitions have their midpoint on the cut frame
conventions.sfx: atFrame = frame where the HIT (hit_offset of sfx-manifest) must land, relative to the scene; build one master SFX track at absolute frames (scene start + atFrame - hit_offset) so tails and lead-ins can cross scene boundaries. gainDb is relative to the bed nominal level (style 7.3).
conventions.camera: camera[].atFrame = arrival frame; the move runs over the frames given in ease; zoom interpolates in log space; tilt = plane rotateX/rotateY (deg); anchor = screen point where the target lands (Screen CameraKey.anchor)
conventions.cursor: cursor[].atFrame = arrival (click frames are on beats); rendered in screen space, 30-34 px tall, scale capped at 1.5x with camera zoom; enters from off-frame or fades in at a rest point, never teleports
conventions.privacy: never used: timeline.png, timeline-selected.png, timeline-reclassify.png, reports-generated.png, og.png, any brand/ai/* provider logo. report-1-meta (model id) and settings model-fields are kept out of frame; no Gmail/e-mail row is ever a camera target.

music.key: A minor (relative of C major: the shimmer/sweep SFX are C-major pentatonic, the risers end on A4, dings C6/E6)
music.tempo: 120 BPM, 4/4, 24 bars = 48.0 s; the track starts ON a hit at frame 0 (no pickup); last sample of the tail <= frame 1439
music.progression: Am - F - C - G (i-VI-III-VII), one chord per bar; breakdown Fmaj7 -> Am9; drop = the main riff over Am - F - C - G; final stab Am(add9); last note a low A + A5 bell
music.mix: bed nominal -6 dB (BED 0.5); ducks: -5 dB at 210/225/240 and 1080/1095/1110/1125 (slams), -6 dB at 1200 (drop), -4 dB at 1260 (final hit); master -14 LUFS integrated, <= -1 dBTP; short-term: cold open ~-15, grooves ~-12, breakdown ~-18, drop ~-11 LUFS

sections.name: Cold open (product first)
sections.description: Hit on frame 0 (kick + sub + short Am stab + crash), then a driving 8th-note bass pedal on A under a low-passed pluck arp (A-C-E-G), LPF opening 800 Hz -> 2 kHz over the 2 bars; closed hats on 16ths from bar 2; 1-beat snare fill into bar 3. No melody yet.

events.note: track starts on a hit: poster frame, the 3D push begins
bar 2 kick, 16th hats enter; camera continues (match cut)
snare fill + LPF fully open into bar 3

sections.name: Groove A (Classifica)
sections.description: Full groove: four-on-the-floor kick, sidechained saw bass (Am-F-C-G), clap on 2 and 4, 16th pluck arp. Stop-time stabs (band hits together) under the three slams, crash on the third.

events.note: groove enters exactly on the whip midpoint (S02 -> S03)
stab under "Regras," (beat 3 of bar 4)
stab under "memória,"
stab + crash under "IA." (bar 5 downbeat)
tom accent on the cut to Revisão (beat 4)
1-beat fill that sets up the stop

sections.name: Groove B (Revisa) with stop-time
sections.description: Bar 7 opens with a band STOP: one stab on the downbeat, then only a sub tail + closed hat 8ths for 2 beats so the key-down (375) is heard alone; groove re-enters on 390 with an added counter-melody (bell, C-major pentatonic E5-G5-A5) and open hats on the off-beats.

events.note: stab on the downbeat then stop (keycap scene) - near silence 361-389
gap reserved for the key-down SFX (contact on the beat)
groove re-enters on beat 3 as the key morphs into the UI
snare accent on the cut to "Confirmar os 19"
crash + chord change on the click (bar 9 downbeat)
cut to the empty queue
clap + A5 bell on UBI's landing (beat 3 of bar 10)

sections.name: Groove C (Entrega + Foco)
sections.description: Brighter arp, octave bass, ride on quarters; a low synth "no" stab for the intervention. Keeps the same drum pattern so the section feels like a lift, not a new song.

events.note: cut to Relatórios (beat 2 accent)
crash on the "Copiar Markdown" click (bar 12 downbeat)
snare accent on the cut to Foco (beat 4)
low "no" stab as the intervention window pops (beat 4 of bar 13)
accent on the "Ok, foco!" click (beat 4 of bar 14)

sections.name: Lift (Você escolhe a IA)
sections.description: Drums thin to kick + hats, warm pad enters, filter slightly closed; a down-sweep at the end of bar 16 hands over to the breakdown.

events.note: whip midpoint into Configurações (bar 15 downbeat)
"IA do Ubi" click (bar 16 downbeat)
LPF closes into the breakdown

sections.name: Breakdown (privacy breather)
sections.description: Kick out. Pad Fmaj7 -> Am9, soft plucks, sub pulse on quarters; the most open, calm moment. The 2-bar riser (SFX) starts in the last 15 frames.

events.note: soft pad swell at the blur-dissolve midpoint (bar 17)
riser-2bar.wav starts (its end lands on 1185)

sections.name: Build (Captura / Classifica / Revisa / Entrega + recap)
sections.description: Kick back on quarters, stabs under the four slams, snare roll 4ths -> 8ths (1140) -> 16ths (1170), HPF + LPF sweep up, bass on 8ths; then a FULL STOP on beat 4 of bar 20: 15 frames of true digital silence.

events.note: build starts, stab under "Captura." (bar 19)
stab "Classifica."
stab "Revisa."
stab "Entrega."
snare roll to 8ths, sweep up (bar 20)
recap flash montage starts (beat 2 of bar 20): cuts ride the snare 8ths
snare roll to 16ths (recap flash cuts on 16ths)
PRE-REVEAL SILENCE 1185-1199 (15 f): everything stops, picture = canvas + grain

sections.name: Drop (ubiqX AI)
sections.description: The drop: main riff (saw lead, A minor) + full drums + sub + big crash; the loudest bar of the film.

events.note: wordmark slam + flash; sub boom + deep impact (SFX)

sections.name: Final hit + tail (end card)
sections.description: Final hit on 1260 (Am(add9) stab + crash + sub) and the groove stops; a 2-bar tail of pad, reverb and a soft C-major-pentatonic arp echo decaying; one last soft "button" note on bar 24; the tail is fully decayed by frame 1435 (no fade needed, never trails past the picture).

events.note: FINAL HIT on the end card (bar 22 downbeat)
soft button: low A + A5 bell (bar 24)
last audible sample; 1436-1439 silent, picture holds the end card
